in_greek.name: Flo
in_greek.long_meaning: Flo είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Latin word ‘flos’, meaning ‘flower’ or ‘blossom’. In biblical usage, it can refer to a flood or an overflowing of grace.

in_latin.name: Flo
in_latin.long_meaning: Flo est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Latin word ‘flos’, meaning ‘flower’ or ‘blossom’. In biblical usage, it can refer to a flood or an overflowing of grace.
